negative_reviews.author: Ilh
negative_reviews.text:
(Translated by Google) It was very good. However, I recommend ordering via the QR code on the table if you want to choose whether or not to leave a tip, as you pay directly online and the choice is yours. Otherwise, the server will automatically add a tip to your bill without asking your permission.

(Original)
C’était très bon. Cependant je vous conseille de commander via le QR code sur la table, si vous voulez choisir de donner un pourboire ou non car vous payez directement en ligne et c’est à vous de choisir. Sinon, le serveur ou la serveuse ajoutera un pourboire automatiquement à votre note sans vous demander votre permission.

issues: Sales rose 4.6% to £74.8K, matching the franchise numbers, and covers increased.
Spend per head dipped slightly to £21.35 because of the app reward changes, which have made splitting tabs easier.
Labour was 19.6% and food cost 22.24%, recovering from the previous week's frozen ramen spike.
The frozen student ramen promotion ended with only one given away because of date confusion on the app.
Food and drink variances were below 5%, the efficiency score was 96, and labour hours were slightly higher because of a busier week, with national insurance skewing the budget comparison.
Staffing: Nabina is covering from Thursday to Monday.
Site compliance was 94% on time, with a reminder not to submit checklists too early.
Maintenance: the open tank behind the grease trap pumps water out when the ramen boiler is drained, and Ross is arranging a fix.
The Yuzu margarita special continues to be popular and is running on at Ross's request.
The new app rewards showed no usage, pointing to a system error that Oisin also hit when creating a test account.
Customers keep asking about £5 ramen because of earlier account sign ups and TikTok posts.
To lift spend per head, Oisin told the team to upsell edamame for a quick turnaround and to default to pairing ramen with a sushi roll rather than a side.
actions: Upsell edamame and default to a ramen and sushi roll pairing to improve spend per head - Owner: Rory Ferguson (10/11/2026)
